title: 高盛Kendra Lau：AI组合大调整，硬件之后应用接棒？
speaker: Kendra Lau

segments.en: So we think that we're likely to pull a floor, Alice, in the short term, when it comes to liquidity and sentiment. You also refreshed your China Select AI portfolio.
segments.zh: 所以，Alice，我们认为短期内流动性和情绪可能见底。你也更新了中国精选AI组合。

segments.en: How did you refresh it? Is hardware still a big theme? Isn't that portfolio?
segments.zh: 你是怎么更新的？硬件还是重要主题吗？那个组合里？

segments.en: I think the key word here is really diversification.
segments.zh: 我觉得关键词其实是多元化。

segments.en: Sorry to say that, but I listened to what Anthony just talked about in terms of the Chinese AI ecosystem ramping up.
segments.zh: 很抱歉这么说，但我听了Anthony刚才讲的中国AI生态加速发展。

segments.en: So in a report that we put out a few weeks ago, essentially, we really tried to emphasize on that subject.
segments.zh: 所以在我们几周前发布的一份报告中，我们确实试图强调这个主题。

segments.en: I think the narrative of a global AI deal openly is definitely gaining traction among investors.
segments.zh: 我认为全球AI共识的叙事肯定在市场参与者中越来越有吸引力。

segments.en: So when you look at the Chinese AI ecosystem, actually, there are two parts of the ecosystem.
segments.zh: 所以当你审视中国AI生态时，实际上有两个部分。

segments.en: One is more export oriented. So Chinese AI companies that are exporting the products to the West, right?
segments.zh: 一部分更偏向出口导向。也就是中国AI公司把产品出口到西方，对吧？

segments.en: So they're basically derivatives of the CapEx boom in the US.
segments.zh: 所以它们基本上是美国资本开支繁荣的衍生品。

segments.en: But at the same time, the other major part of the picture is really the Chinese AI companies primarily serving the domestic market.
segments.zh: 但同时，另一个主要部分是中国AI公司主要服务内地市场。

segments.en: They don't really export that much to the world, but they really do their business on shore.
segments.zh: 他们对外出口并不多，业务主要在国内。

segments.en: So that's why we create two different baskets to help investors better position for that development in the future.
segments.zh: 因此我们构建了两个不同的组合，帮助市场参与者更好地布局未来这一趋势。

segments.en: So we still like the exporters, but at the same time, I think if investors want to really trade for the more idiosyncratic opportunities within the AI ecosystem,
segments.zh: 我们仍看好出口型企业，但同时，如果市场参与者想把握AI生态内更独特的机会，

segments.en: I think the domestic names would benefit that.
segments.zh: 我认为本土企业将从中受益。
